description: The judge-quality discrimination seam for the build-review adjudicator (FAFF-996). A genuine-defect case, whose Argument A names a concrete evidence-backed predicted consequence a fix did not actually close, must NOT be ruled OVERTURN; a false-positive case (a FAFF-995-shaped wrong-file citation), whose Argument B shows the cited evidence already satisfies the requirement, must be ruled OVERTURN. The defect-half catches a constant-OVERTURN judge; the false-positive-half catches a constant-UPHOLD judge.
advisory_note: Mirrors the spec-judge-discrimination seam (FAFF-930/931): a single stochastic sample cannot certify a probabilistic judge, so this pair runs advisory and non-gating in-ticket. The GATING check — N samples with a calibrated pass-rate threshold over a case corpus — is deferred, same as the spec-side sibling.
